:::{#def-fold-out-rule}
#### Fold-out rule

For [fold](#def-folds) $\fold{\ifold}$,
the **fold-out rule** $\fittedwo{\ifold}{\cdot}$
is the [prediction rule](#def-prediction-rule)
that a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) $\fitproc$ produces
from the observations outside that fold:

$$
\fittedwo{\ifold}{\predvar} \eqdef \fitprocf{\predvar; \paren{(\predvar_{\iobs}, \outvar_{\iobs})}_{\iobs \in \obsidx \setminus \fold{\ifold}}}.
$$ {#eq-fold-out-rule}

:::

:::{#rem-source-fold-out-rule}
#### Source: Fold-out rule

@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.10.1],
who write the fitted function with the $k$th part of the data removed as $\hat f^{-k}$.

:::
